en-US.description: GestureSign is a gesture recognition software for Windows tablet. You can automate repetitive tasks by simply drawing a gesture with your fingers or mouse.
en-US.longDescription:
GestureSign is a gesture recognition software for Windows tablet. You can automate repetitive tasks by simply drawing a gesture with your fingers or mouse.

GestureSign supports the following commands:
- Activate Window
- Window Control
- Touch Keyboard Control
- Keyboard simulation
- Key Down/Up
- Mouse Simulation
- Send Keystrokes
- Open Default Browser
- Screen Brightness
- Volume Adjustment
- Run Command or Program
- Launch Windows Store App
- Send Message
- Toggle Window Topmost
en-US.name: GestureSign
